title: Crompond School sees 36 Asian and Pacific Islander students enrolled for 2025-26
text:
Crompond School enrolled 36 Asian and Pacific Islander students in the 2025-26 school year, marking an increase of 24.1% from the prior year, the New York State Education Department reported.
The data indicated that the total enrollment for Crompond School was 531 during the 2025-26 school year. Asian and Pacific Islander students represented 6.8% of the student population, making them the third largest ethnic group at the school.
Crompond School is part of the Yorktown Central School District, overseen from its central office in Yorktown Heights.
Out of the district’s five schools, Yorktown High School had the highest count of Asian and Pacific Islander students at that time, totaling 76.
New York holds the second highest ranking in the nation for K-12 public education spending , with current expenditures at $30,012 per student, nearly twice the national average of $16,526, according to the Education Data Initiative.
